variants.headline: Looking back: colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The colony was openly defying its charter.

The colony is openly defying its charter. A big gesture, a serious question. But do not write the punishment into the story before it has been established. Readers can ask whether defiance is brave, reckless or justified without being sold a confrontation that belongs to somebody's imagination.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We defend {target} in this assessment. Compliance is not the only possible political virtue, and a fair hearing must allow a principled challenge to authority rather than treating defiance as self-proving guilt.
